question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

One answer to the ________ of air pollution is to build a car that does not pollute.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"problem"** means a matter or situation regarded as unwelcome or harmful and needing to be dealt with and overcome. (समस्या)

 
 
• **Example: **Finding a solution to the** problem** of global warming is crucial for the future of our planet.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Basis **(आधार): The underlying support or foundation for an idea, argument, or process.

 
 
• **Example:** The basis of his argument is flawed.
 
 
 
• **Resolution **(संकल्प): A firm decision to do or not to do something, or the action of solving a problem or contentious matter.
 
 
• **Example:** The resolution to the conflict was finally achieved after several months of negotiation.
 
 
 
• **Measure** (माप): A plan or course of action taken to achieve a particular purpose.
 
 
• **Example:** New safety measures were implemented to prevent accidents.
